scripts.build:client: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist/client', { recursive: true, force: true })" && esbuild public/js/app.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2020 --minify --loader:.png=dataurl --outfile=dist/client/public/js/app.js
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.dev:client: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist/client', { recursive: true, force: true })" && esbuild public/js/app.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2020 --sourcemap --loader:.png=dataurl --outfile=dist/client/public/js/app.js
scripts.dev: npm run build:server && npm run dev:client && node dist/server/index.js
